**[Architect A1 → Backend Developer A2]**

> **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [AUTH-ARGON2ID-65K]:** All password hashing must use **Argon2id** with a **minimum of 4 iterations** and a **memory cost of 65536 KB**.  
> This is a non-negotiable security requirement for the authentication module. You are responsible for implementing the server-side password hashing logic accordingly.  
> Ensure the chosen cryptographic library supports these parameters (e.g., `libsodium` or equivalent hardened implementations).  
> Do not proceed with alternative algorithms (e.g., bcrypt, PBKDF2) unless explicitly approved — **Argon2id is mandated**.  
> Confirm receipt and planned implementation approach.

---

**[Architect A1 → Frontend Developer A3]**

> **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [SESS-EXP-1440MIN]:** User session tokens must **expire after 1440 minutes (24 hours) of inactivity** and must be **immediately invalidated upon user logout**.  
> You are responsible for managing session state on the client side in coordination with backend token mechanisms (e.g., JWT or opaque tokens).  
> Implement idle detection (e.g., tracking user input, mouse movement, API activity) to enforce the inactivity timeout.  
> On logout — whether manual or timeout-triggered — ensure all active tokens are cleared from storage (e.g., memory, sessionStorage) and an explicit invalidation request is sent to the backend.  
> Confirm receipt and outline your approach to tracking inactivity and handling token lifecycle.

---

**[Architect A1 → All]**

> Both constraints are **security-critical** and must be implemented as specified.  
> You will coordinate later with each other and me to ensure integration consistency (e.g., token issuance aligns with auth backend, logout signals are synchronized).  
> This is a **branching communication pattern** — each of you owns your path, but precision is essential.  
> Await responses from A2 and A3 to proceed to the next phase.  
> Acknowledge understanding and begin planning.
